entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Provide a way like `nvm` to mange .NET SDKs #49862
  • How can I restore a single dotnet tool according to the local tool manifest? #49860
  • Update MSTest in test templates (template_feed directory) to 3.9.3 #49856
  • No variable values in debugger despite working breakpoints (arm64 + CLion + corerun + LLDB) #49855

Closed

  • Cannot find project info.... This can indicate a missing project reference , C:\Program Files\dotnet\sdk\2.1.505\Sdks\Microsoft.NET.Sdk\targets\Microsoft.NET.Sdk.targets #10332
    Discussion
  • Build issue when targeting .NET core 2.1 on machine with only .NET Core SDK 2.2 #3272
    Discussion
